title: Filipino Grilled Fish Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish from the Philippines, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. This recipe features fish marinated in a mixture of Filipino spices and grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Pineapple juice
ingredients.notes: or a mixture of pineapple and orange juice

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together pineapple juice, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt.
2. Add the fish fillets to the marinade and mix to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Remove the fish from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
6. Thread the fish onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
7. Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
8. Grill the fish for 4-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
9. Serve the fish hot, garnished with lime wedges and a sprinkle of salt.
